note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Tokelau: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Tokelau does not take New Zealand's income tax: the General Fono has the power to impose its own taxes, and Tokelau collects a tax on employees' pay (budgeted at NZD 1.25 million in 2016/17); its rates were not found.
figures.applies: Tokelau's own income tax (Income Tax Rules made by the General Fono); rates are a blocker.

sources.said: Confers on the General Fun a power to make rues for Tokelau, including the power to impose taxes,
Until such time as the General Fono makes rules under section 3A of the principal Act (as inserted by section 3 of this Act) imposing any levy or tax on income,
APPENDIX 1: REVENUE FY2016/17 2016/2017 Budget Change on previous year (%) -11.7% Taxes 2.500
